name: central-opencode-adapter
transport: per-session `opencode serve` on loopback (HTTP REST + JSON polling)
bodyCapNote: Measured 2026-11-17 across live turns: largest single REST body ~5 KB (interrupted story message list). Same 8 MiB ceiling posture as the stdio gateways: oversize/unparseable bodies fail the poll as reconcile-required, never partial facts.

schemaProvenance.reason: REST surface read from the live server's own OpenAPI (`GET /openapi.json`, 139 paths on 2.2.7) and exercised live on 2026-11-17: session.create -> prompt -> assistant message with tokens, permission list (empty: default rules auto-approved), Basic auth capture. The permission request+reply cycle is schema-captured but NOT live-denied (nothing asked).
schemaProvenance.schemaSource: opencode serve 2.2.7 /openapi.json (captured 2026-11-17, kept outside the repo)
schemaProvenance.liveHandshakeVerified: 2.2.7: Basic auth, session.create/prompt/message/permission list + permission reply reject (edit ask-rule lab: reject lands, request resolves, model re-asks); interrupt schema-only

policies.oversizeFrame: close transport, require reconciliation, never parse partial event
policies.secretHandling: logs and request errors redact token/secret/authorization material; the server password lives only in the child environment, never logged or persisted
policies.modelMismatch: requested/observed model mismatch is a capability error, never silent fallback
policies.usageSource: usage is harvested from completed assistant message tokens (input/output/reasoning/cache), evidence-only, never ledgered
